# Pinned Bambu Studio public ABI header

`bambu_networking.hpp` is the unmodified public header from BambuStudio tag `v02.08.02.61`:

https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/blob/v02.08.02.61/src/slic3r/Utils/bambu_networking.hpp

The upstream project license is retained as `LICENSE.BambuStudio`. The proprietary networking plugin is not copied or redistributed; the sender loads the user's existing installed plugin. Header layout is part of the C++ ABI; the helper refuses other ABI series.
